```yaml
lines:
  - id: s2.line1z
    printed: "1z"
    label: "Add lines 1a through 1y"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: s2.line1a}
    refuses: [s2.credit_recapture, s2.other_tax, s2.h_ev_dealer]
    note: "Only line 1a (Form 8962, line 29) is computed. Lines 1b and 1c (repayment of clean vehicle credits transferred to a dealer) are refused through s2.h_ev_dealer. Lines 1d to 1f (Form 4255 recapture and excessive payments) and line 1y (for example, recapture of the refueling property credit) are refused through s2.credit_recapture and s2.other_tax."

  - id: s2.h_ev_dealer
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Transferred a clean vehicle credit to a registered dealer (Schedule 2, lines 1b and 1c may apply)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [s3.ev, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [s3.ev_dealer, {const: true}]}

  # ---------------- Form 6251 (AMT), figured for Schedule 2, line 2 ----------------
  - id: s2.h_l1a
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 6251 line 1a: Subtract Schedule 1-A (Form 1040), line 37, from Form 1040, line 14"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: f1040.line14, take: s1a.line37}

  - id: s2.h_l1b
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 6251 line 1b: Subtract line 1a from Form 1040, line 11b (if less than zero, enter as a negative amount)"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: f1040.line11b, take: s2.h_l1a}

  - id: s2.h_age_boxes
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of age (65 or older) boxes checked for the standard deduction"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.age65_box, {const: true}]}

  - id: s2.h_blind_boxes
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of blindness boxes checked for the standard deduction"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.blind, {const: true}]}

  - id: s2.h_std_base
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Basic standard deduction for the filing status"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: sa.standard_base}

  - id: s2.h_std_extra
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Additional standard deduction per box for the filing status"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: sa.standard_extra}

  - id: s2.h_std_age
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Additional standard deduction for the age boxes"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: multiply_count, amount: s2.h_std_extra, count: s2.h_age_boxes}

  - id: s2.h_std_blind
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Additional standard deduction for the blindness boxes"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: multiply_count, amount: s2.h_std_extra, count: s2.h_blind_boxes}

  - id: s2.h_std
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Standard deduction amount for this return"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [s2.h_std_base, s2.h_std_age, s2.h_std_blind]}

  - id: s2.h_itemized
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Filing Schedule A (Form 1040), that is, itemizing deductions"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, ne: [f1040.line12e, s2.h_std]}
    note: "Open point: the catalog has no line saying whether the return itemizes. Chosen reading: the return itemizes when Form 1040, line 12e, differs from the standard deduction figured from the filing status and the age and blindness boxes. This misreads a return that elects to itemize, or must itemize, when its itemized total exactly equals the standard deduction. It also misreads a married-filing-separately return that claims age or blindness boxes for the spouse."

  - id: s2.h_l2a
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 6251 line 2a: If filing Schedule A, enter the taxes from Schedule A, line 7; otherwise, enter the amount from Form 1040, line 12e"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [s2.h_itemized, {const: true}]}
          then: sa.line7
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [s2.h_itemized, {const: false}]}
          then: f1040.line12e

  - id: s2.h_recovery_8z
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Recoveries of earlier-year deductions included on Schedule 1, line 8z"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: oi8z
      field: oi8z.amount
      where: {op: test, eq: [oi8z.kind, {const: "recovery"}]}

  - id: s2.h_has_recovery
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "A line 8z recovery that may be a refund of personal property, sales or real property tax (Form 6251, line 2b)"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [s2.h_recovery_8z, {const: 0}]}

  - id: s2.h_l2b
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 6251 line 2b: Tax refund from Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 1 or line 8z (entered in parentheses; held here as a positive amount)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: s1.line1}
    refuses: [s2.h_has_recovery]
    note: "Only the Schedule 1, line 1 refund (state or local income tax) is computed. A line 8z recovery is refused, because this tool cannot tell which part of it is a refund of the taxes the instruction names."

  - id: s2.h_l2g
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 6251 line 2g: Interest from specified private activity bonds exempt from the regular tax"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: s2.amt_pab}
    note: "The amount is taken from box 9 of Forms 1099-INT. Specified private activity bond interest dividends (Form 1099-DIV, box 13) are assumed to be refused through the dividend screening (div.other_boxes). The reduction for deductions that would have been allowable is not modelled."

  - id: s2.h_l2c_refuse
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 6251 line 2c may apply: itemized investment interest expense along with private activity bond interest"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [s2.h_itemized, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [f4952.has_interest, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, gt: [s2.amt_pab, {const: 0}]}

  - id: s2.h_iso_refuse
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 6251 line 2i may apply: incentive stock options exercised and kept, or vesting in 2025"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [s2.options_any, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [s2.iso, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [s2.iso_vested, {const: true}]}

  - id: s2.h_l2l
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 6251 line 2l: Depreciation on assets placed in service after 1986 (difference between regular tax and AMT)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.amt_dep}
    note: "Open point: the meaning of person.amt_dep is not stated. Chosen reading: it is each person's Schedule C depreciation adjustment (regular tax less AMT). The related income-based adjustments on line 3 (section 179 limit, SEP, self-employed health insurance) are not refigured."

  - id: s2.h_l4_adds
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Lines 1b, 2a, 2g and 2l combined"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [s2.h_l1b, s2.h_l2a, s2.h_l2g, s2.h_l2l]}

  - id: s2.h_l4_pre
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 6251 line 4 before the married-filing-separately addition: combine lines 1b through 3"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: s2.h_l4_adds, take: s2.h_l2b}

  - id: s2.h_mfs_excess
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Excess of line 4 over $900,350"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: s2.h_l4_pre, take: {param: amt.mfs_addback_start}}

  - id: s2.h_mfs_quarter
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "25% of the excess of line 4 over $900,350"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: multiply_rate, amount: s2.h_mfs_excess, rate: {param: amt.rate_25}}

  - id: s2.h_mfs_max
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Maximum additional amount ($68,500)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: amt.mfs_addback_max}

  - id: s2.h_mfs_add
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Additional amount to include on line 4 if married filing separately"

  - id: s2.h_l4_mfs
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 4 including the married-filing-separately additional amount"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [s2.h_l4_pre, s2.h_mfs_add]}

  - id: s2.h_l4

        - guard: {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}

  - id: s2.h_ex_full
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Exemption Worksheet line 1: $88,100 / $137,000 / $68,500"

  - id: s2.h_p12

        - guard: {op: test, eq: [sd.filed, {const: false}]}

    printed: "(helper)"

        - guard: {op: test, eq: [s2.h_p18_low, {const: false}]}

    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: s2.h_l9, take: s2.h_l10}
    refuses: [s2.amt_business, s2.amt_boat, s2.h_iso_refuse, s2.h_l2c_refuse, sa.dependent, sa.excluded_income]
    note: "This is Form 6251, line 11 (subtract line 10 from line 9; if zero or less, enter -0-). Lines 10 and 20 are not added."

  - id: s2.other
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Another additional tax applies that this tool does not compute (Schedule 2 lines 17a, 17b, 17d, 17n or 17z, or line 1y)"
